extensionDescription.message: Notifications for the endless scroll. Shows a notification when you scroll past a set threshold.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in add-ons manager.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the toolbar icon.

popupExplainer.message: A gentle reminder when you scroll too far.
popupExplainer.description: Short explainer sentence shown in the popup header.

popupGlobalToggleLabel.description: Visible label next to the global enable switch in the popup header.

unitScreensOne.description: Unit label for number of screens scrolled (singular).

unitScreensFew.description: Unit label for number of screens scrolled (few).

unitScreensMany.description: Unit label for number of screens scrolled (many).

unitScreensOther.description: Unit label for number of screens scrolled (other).

popupThresholdTitle.message: After how many screens should Surfaced remind you?
popupThresholdTitle.description: Title for the main threshold section in the popup.

popupThresholdHelperScreens.message: 1 screen = the height of the visible part of the page.
popupThresholdHelperScreens.description: Helper text explaining the meaning of one screen.

popupThresholdCustomHint.message: You can also enter a custom value, for example 5.5 or 20.
popupThresholdCustomHint.description: Helper text explaining that custom threshold values are supported.

popupThresholdBehaviorHint.description: Helper text explaining the later depth zones.

notificationTextReset.description: Button label that restores the default notification text.

popupNotificationTextTitle.description: Title for the popup section that customizes the shallow reminder copy.

popupNotificationTextHint.message: This text appears in the first reminder.
popupNotificationTextHint.description: Helper text under the reminder text section title.

popupPreviewLabel.description: Label above the inline reminder preview in the popup.

enabledOnSite.description: Label for the per-site toggle when no hostname is available.

enabledOnHost.description: Label for the per-site toggle showing the current hostname.

statusAutoSaved.description: Brief auto-save confirmation shown after debounced saves.

statusEnabled.description: Status message after globally enabling the extension.

statusDisabled.description: Status message after globally disabling the extension.

statusEnabledOnHost.description: Status message after enabling on a specific site.

statusDisabledOnHost.description: Status message after disabling on a specific site.

ariaThresholdValue.description: Aria label for the main threshold input.

ariaDecreaseThreshold.description: Aria label for the button that decreases the global threshold.

ariaIncreaseThreshold.description: Aria label for the button that increases the global threshold.

ariaThresholdHelpToggle.message: Show more information about the threshold setting
ariaThresholdHelpToggle.description: Aria label for the button that toggles the threshold help text.

ariaToggleGlobal.description: Aria label for the global enable toggle.

ariaSiteThresholdValue.description: Aria label for the site-specific threshold input.

ariaDecreaseSiteThreshold.description: Aria label for the button that decreases the site-specific threshold.

ariaIncreaseSiteThreshold.description: Aria label for the button that increases the site-specific threshold.

defaultNotificationText.message: You've drifted pretty far. Come up for air.
defaultNotificationText.description: Default notification text shown when the user scrolls past the threshold.

notificationSub.description: Subtitle shown below the notification title.

ariaNotificationDismiss.description: Aria label for the notification close button.

notificationMid.message: Still going? You're deep in the feed now.
notificationMid.description: Notification text for the Mid (2x threshold) depth zone.

notificationDeep.message: You've been down here a while. Time to surface.
notificationDeep.description: Notification text for the Deep (3x threshold) depth zone.

popupSiteTitle.description: Section title for the current site settings block.

popupSiteTitleFallback.description: Fallback title for the current site settings block when no hostname is available.

popupSiteDescription.message: Adjust how Surfaced behaves on the page you're viewing.
popupSiteDescription.description: Description text below the current site section title.

popupCurrentSiteUnavailable.message: Site-specific settings are unavailable here because Surfaced could not read the current page address.
popupCurrentSiteUnavailable.description: Fallback message shown when the popup cannot resolve the current hostname.

siteOverrideEnabled.message: Use a different value on this site
siteOverrideEnabled.description: Label for the checkbox to enable site-specific override.

popupSiteOverrideToggleLabel.message: Use a different value on this site
popupSiteOverrideToggleLabel.description: Visible label for enabling a site-specific threshold override.

popupSiteOverrideInputLabel.description: Label above the site-specific threshold input controls.

manageSites.description: Label for the button that expands the saved site settings list.

noOverrides.description: Message shown when the saved site settings list is empty.

statusOverrideEnabled.description: Status message when a custom threshold is enabled.

statusOverrideDisabled.description: Status message when a custom threshold is disabled.

statusOverrideRemoved.description: Status message when an override is deleted from the management list.

ariaRemoveSiteOverride.description: Aria label for the button that removes a saved site-specific setting.
